description: Route les logs applicatifs Kubernetes vers un data stream partage par cluster et environnement

set.if: (ctx.service == null || ctx.service.name == null || ctx.service.name == '') && ctx.log != null && ctx.log.file != null && ctx.log.file.path != null && ctx.log.file.path.contains('/order-service-')

(ctx.service == null || ctx.service.name == null || ctx.service.name == '') && ctx.log != null && ctx.log.file != null && ctx.log.file.path != null && ctx.log.file.path.contains('/inventory-service-')

ctx.service != null && ctx.service.name != null && ctx.service.name != '' && (ctx.service.environment == null || ctx.service.environment == '') && ctx.log != null && ctx.log.file != null && ctx.log.file.path != null && ctx.log.file.path.contains('_supermarket-demo_')
ctx.service != null && ctx.service.environment != null && ctx.service.environment != '' && (ctx.data_stream == null || ctx.data_stream.dataset != 'apm.app.kubernetes')

reroute.if: ctx.service != null && ctx.service.environment != null && ctx.service.environment != '' && (ctx.data_stream == null || ctx.data_stream.dataset != 'apm.app.kubernetes')
